title: A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model
summary:
arXiv:2606.20657v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Post-training a frontier model is normally weeks of human work: proposing data and recipe changes, launching runs, reading evals, deciding what to keep. We report an autonomous system that runs this loop with no human in the loop, post-training a 30B Nemotron across four rounds over multiple weeks.
